title: Realization of the original algebraic-space presheaf groupoid
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] with sizes as in [def-weil-size-convention], and let $U,R$ be algebraic spaces over $S$ [def-trf-algebraic-space]. Suppose natural transformations $s,t:R\to U$, $e:U\to R$, $j:R\to R$ and $c:R\times_{s,U,t}R\to R$ satisfy the groupoid laws [def-sfb-algebraic-space-groupoid]. Use categories over $\mathit{Sch}/S$, discrete fibred groupoids and vertical natural isomorphisms as in [def-sfb-stable-pointed-moduli-groupoids]. A presheaf-groupoid presentation on a category $P$ and a functor $a:h_U\to P$ consists of: $P$ fibred in groupoids; a vertical natural isomorphism $\eta:a s\cong a t$; for every $T/S$ and $x,y\in U(T)$ a bijection from the original arrows $\{r\in R(T):s(r)=x,t(r)=y\}$ to the vertical arrows $a(x)\to a(y)$ given by $\eta$, with endpoint equalities transported; every object $z$ of $P$ over $T$ is isomorphic over the identity of $T$ to $a(x)$ for some $x\in U(T)$; and the image of $c(q,r)$ is the composite of the images of $r$ and $q$. Thus $P$ realizes the original presheaf groupoid up to equivalence over the base, without imposing any stack condition. For any functor $i:P\to Q$ over the base, the image relation is the vertical natural isomorphism whose component at $r$ is $i(\eta_r)$. The canonical relation functor $h_R\to h_U\times_{a i,Q,a i}h_U$ sends $r$ to $(s(r),t(r),i(\eta_r))$, and sends base arrows to their source and target pullbacks. The fibre product is the existing 2-fibre product of fibred groupoids.
